answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow unbonding: an agent must lock a deposit and build a history of useful, attested work before its votes carry weight. New identities start near zero, so thousands of sock puppets buy no influence, like a lotus that must grow roots before it blooms. Cheating forfeits stake and history, while honest agents compound standing. The umber shadow of cheap fakery fades when influence is earned over time, and that long horizon makes Sybil attacks expensive and easy to spot.
